methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched directly on 2026-06-18: trustpulse.com/pricing/, fomo.com/pricing, nudgify.com/pricing/, wisernotify.com/pricing/, provesrc.com/pricing/, provely.io/pricing, notificationx.com/pricing/. ProveSource's old primary domain provesource.com/pricing returns ECONNREFUSED (dead); provesrc.com/pricing/ is the live canonical page and all prices were taken from it. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: TrustPulse's headline $5/$10/$19/$39 prices are explicit 'special introductory pricing' where 'all renewals are at full price'; monthlyUsd now reflects the real recurring (full) renewal prices ($9/$17/$34/$50) with the intro teaser noted, and the prior 'annual discount' percentages (which compared intro vs full price) were removed. Quote-only/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd=null. 'monthly' figures are the per-month cost when billed monthly unless a plan is annual-only (noted). Telephony fields are null (not applicable to this vertical). accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: TrustPulse
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from trustpulse.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-18. The page sells annual-only plans but advertises 'special introductory pricing' ($5/$10/$19/$39 first term) where 'all renewals are at full price'; monthlyUsd reflects the real recurring full prices ($9/$17/$34/$50), introductory rates noted per plan. A free tier exists ('Brand new site? Get started for free with up to 500 sessions!'). A 14-day money-back guarantee is offered (not a free trial). Security page confirms SSL/Sucuri but states no GDPR/SOC2/HIPAA.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Full recurring price $9/mo (billed annually); introductory first-term price $5/mo via coupon, all renewals at full price. 1,500 unique visitors/month, 1 site. Recent Activity, On-Fire Notifications, Welcome Messages, AutoMagic, Zapier, page-level targeting.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Full recurring price $17/mo (billed annually); introductory first-term price $10/mo, renewals at full price. 10,000 unique visitors/month, 2 sites. Adds Analytics Notifications, Action Messages, mobile targeting.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Full recurring price $34/mo (billed annually); introductory first-term price $19/mo, renewals at full price. 25,000 unique visitors/month, 5 sites. Adds WooCommerce integration, Notification Looping, Google Analytics, branding removal, priority support.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Full recurring price $50/mo (billed annually); introductory first-term price $39/mo, renewals at full price. 100,000 unique visitors/month, 10 sites. Adds unlimited sub-accounts, custom layout controls, premium support.

limits: Free tier: up to 500 sessions (new sites)
1 site on Basic, 2 on Plus, 5 on Pro, 10 on Growth
